title: Dark Mode Very Much Matters To Me
partialText: It's not just vibes, it's an accessibility thing.

title: Custom Glow Rings Inside of Elements
partialText: A box-shadow is an obvious choice for an inner glow of an element to highlight it. But with some fancy masking, we can use any overlay style we want.

title: Better Centering with CSS text-box
partialText: Jake has a very nice, clear video about what text-box solves in CSS. It essentially makes even padding on an element (like a button) doable without magic numbers, and that will work across any font (sick). Temani made a tool to help pick the right values.

title: Extracting Grid Information Using CSS
partialText: It's an interesting and potentially useful trick to have an element know where it is on a grid. That's tricky enough when the items are in one row/column, but what about when they span?

title: Code Snacks
partialText: Love these little animations (“code snacks”) from Lauren Basser that illustrate basic technological concepts. Check out the ones for Working Directory and Shadow DOM — not the easiest concepts to illustrate as simply as this!

title: Comparing Values With CSS progress()
partialText: The new CSS progress() function maps a given value to a range. Super useful for responsive layouts, responsive typography, and fun tricks.

title: It’s All About The Permissions Recovery
partialText: Users who deny permissions can recover them by adjusting settings, although many may not realize this.

title: A Deep Dive into StyleX
partialText: StyleX has been around for a while, but it’s seeing a resurgence in popularity lately for whatever reason. Seems pretty good to me. You don’t have to write atomic CSS, but you get atomic CSS output that loads like any other CSS. Kinda like you don’t have to write like Tailwind to get Tailwind-like efficient […]

title: Building a Reliable PostgreSQL Queue: Concurrency, Crashes, Retries, and Scale
partialText: We get into building a background task processor using PostgreSQL. It seems easy at first, but there are lots of pitfalls as a system like this scales.

title: Custom Scrollbar Component In 2026
partialText: Thanks to some very modern CSS, we can visually replicate the logic of scrollbars. Then make them actually functional.
